text:
jo_pm: Quick concept: "Protective Commit Balance" (PCB). Hybrid commit that enforces a minimum baseline but creates a small, auto-replenishing safety buffer for brief spikes. Looking for engineering + ops feasibility before I draft a public spec.

li_eng: sketch the intended UX/mechanics?

jo_pm: basic idea: customer buys baseline B; we maintain a live safety buffer S (e.g., 5% of B) that auto-refills from unused baseline over the month but never creates new committed capacity. Buffer is preemptible and has strict TTL per allocation (e.g., 60s).

ara_ops: so buffer tokens are ephemeral and can be revoked quickly. Ops needs visibility and kill-switch. Also need preemption semantics for in-flight requests.

jo_pm: yes — buffer is explicitly for short tails. Preempt policy = immediate revoke for new requests; in-flight allowed up to grace_tokens G. We'll include feature flags to disable buffer per-region.

michael_sales: customers care about billing clarity. If buffer is used, do we bill at baseline rate, free, or overage? Needs to be simple.

jo_pm: proposal: buffer draws are free while available. If a customer exhausts baseline + buffer, normal overage rates apply. If buffer preempted, no retro billing on consumed buffer.

violet_sre: monitoring/alerts: track buffer_alloc_rate, buffer_preempt_rate, buffer_grace_drops. Page when preempt_rate > 5% for 10m. Also surface customer-facing preemption event streams for transparency.

li_eng: implementation note: router needs per-tenant counters: baseline_remain, buffer_remain, buffer_refill_window. Admission checks baseline first, then buffer. Buffer refill uses a leaky-bucket that moves unused baseline into buffer gradually to avoid end-of-month spikes.

anya_research: QA + eval: create workload synths with microbursts and double-peaks to ensure buffer behavior doesn't mask regressions. Also test under high-occupancy cross-tenant situations to check fairness.

ara_ops: runbook: if buffer_preempt_rate high + region_util > 90%, flip region_buffer_disable and notify capacity oncall + product. Need a one-click dashboard toggle.

michael_sales: product packaging idea: include PCB as default on mid-tier plans, optional on enterprise with configurable S and G. Pilot customers prefer conservative defaults.

li_eng: perf concerns: adding refill logic and per-tenant leaky buckets in hotpath increases state. We can optimize by coalescing refill ticks and sampling heavy tenants only. Still needs perf bench before rollout.

violet_sre: suggest a canary rollout: enable buffers for 10% of pools, monitor latency & tail errors for 48h, then expand. Also need metric for buffer-induced latency delta.

jo_pm: proto config for spec drafting: {mode: "pcb", baseline: 1000000, buffer_pct: 0.05, buffer_ttl_s: 60, grace_tokens: 200, refill_window_s: 3600, preempt_threshold: 0.92}. (I'll put real JSON in spec doc).

li_eng: rough estimate: router + state + perf + canary = 3-4 sprints across infra & serving. Billing mapping + console UX + legal = parallel work.

michael_sales: two pilot bundles: (1) PCB Standard: 5% buffer, default grace; (2) PCB Enterprise: configurable buffer_pct, SLA opt-in for buffer usage. We'll draft pricing comparisons vs plain reserves.

ara_ops: add telemetry to backlog: buffer_consumed, buffer_refilled, buffer_preempt_events, buffer_region_disable_events. Also document rollback: single flag region_buffer_disable for immediate disable.

anya_research: will add eval tickets for quality/regression tests and synthetic multi-tenant stress tests.

violet_sre: small ops note: ensure preempt events are idempotent and logged with request IDs for debugging.

jo_pm: action items: @li_eng prototype admission + refill sim, @ara_ops runbook + toggle UI, @violet_sre canary plan + alerts, @michael_sales pilot packaging, @anya_research eval plan. I'll assemble an initial spec & share next Wed.

li_eng: starting a spike branch tomorrow to simulate refill leaky-bucket behavior.

ara_ops: will mock dashboard toggle in staging this week.

michael_sales: I'll identify 3 pilot customers who asked for smoother burst handling.

anya_research: creating eval tickets and adding synthetic prompts for degradation checks.

violet_sre: acked, will add metric alerts to SRE board.

jo_pm: thanks all — aiming to include PCB in Q3 pilot slate if blockers are small. :rocket:
